blurb: Join us at Lakeside Restaurant in Lanexa, Virginia for a casual American dining experience with an exhilarating view of gorgeous Chickahominy

quotes.text: Good food. Had fried fish and fried chicken, and both were crispy and delicious. House-made ranch was amazing. We sat on the patio in mid July and the breeze off the lake kept it cool enough to enjoy lunch while watching the waves splash and ducks swim by.
We ordered take out. Crab cake sandwich, Turkey Rueben and a steak and cheese sandwich. All of them were delicious!! Great price for the serving. Highly recommend giving them a try.
Nice dog friendly patio with beautiful views of the lake. Everyone was so friendly and we enjoyed our food. Hamburgers and Crab Cake Sandwich was great. Can highly recommend!
